title: Paying Whole Foods prices for a losing basket
gist: Evening Edition teaser: three weeks before Election Day, polls are moving leftward, and Republicans have more cash than Democrats but are burning it faster. Only a short excerpt is available.

insights.claim: With Election Day three weeks away, polls continue to move leftward with enthusiasm, in the same direction as the general vibes.
insights.speaker: Halina Bennet
insights.so_what: Midterm-polling drift toward Democrats matters for policy-risk and sector positioning ahead of November.
insights.locator: With Election Day three weeks away

insights.claim: Republicans hold more cash than Democrats but are spending it faster, including a Kansas rescue effort for Senator Roger Marshall and a Maine ad that ran in Oregon.
insights.speaker: Halina Bennet
insights.so_what: Defensive GOP spending in safe-ish states signals Senate map pressure.
